title: OpenAI and Greek Government launch ‘OpenAI for Greece’
summary: OpenAI and the Greek Government have launched “OpenAI for Greece” to bring ChatGPT Edu into secondary schools and support responsible AI learning. This partnership aims to boost AI literacy, fuel local start-ups, and drive national economic growth.
body: OpenAI and the Greek Government have launched “OpenAI for Greece” to bring ChatGPT Edu into secondary schools and support responsible AI learning. This partnership aims to boost AI literacy, fuel local start-ups, and drive national economic growth.
summaryZh: OpenAI与希腊政府合作启动了“OpenAI for Greece”项目，将ChatGPT Edu引入中等学校，旨在支持负责任的AI学习，提升全民AI素养，并助力当地初创企业与国家经济增长。原始信息显示：OpenAI and the Greek Government have launched “OpenAI for Greece” to bring ChatGPT Edu into secondary schools and support responsible AI learning.
